name: Fontina Grille

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: The current official and linked ordering menus publish ingredients for many dishes but no product-level allergen matrix or complete allergen declarations.

summary: Fontina Grille's active Toast catalog and official catering page enumerate 160 unique current products. The 278-row frozen catalog mixes real products with duplicated spellings, obsolete lunch/brunch and beverage entries, section labels, prices, and ingredient-description fragments; current size variants and normalized spellings are reconciled explicitly. Required searches found no official product-level allergen matrix, so ingredient descriptions were not promoted to complete allergen declarations.
